title: A ponderous Saxon.
html_source: Haines is English, which at the time would have created some animosity between Irish natives who resented England’s control of their nation.

anchor.prefix:
— Yes, my love? 

 — How long is Haines going to stay in this tower? 

 Buck Mulligan showed a shaven cheek over his right shoulder. 

 — God, isn't he dreadful? he said frankly.
anchor.suffix: He thinks you're not a gentleman. God, these bloody English! Bursting with money and indigestion. Because he comes from Oxford. You know, Dedalus, you have the real Oxford manner.
